---
name: Small improvement
about: Suggest a focused improvement; there is no roadmap or response commitment.
---

This is a quick personal project, not a general-purpose fan platform. Suggestions
may receive no response or be declined. Please discuss substantial work before
writing a large PR; silence is not approval.

### Problem

What specific problem are you trying to solve?

### Smallest useful change

Describe the proposed improvement and any simpler alternatives.

### Scope and impact

Which hardware or workflow needs this? Does it affect cooling safety, compatibility,
dependencies or ongoing maintenance?
